commit.message:
test(#2108): keep Unix-socket fixtures under SUN_LEN on macOS

The isolated test runner nests TMPDIR inside the per-user macOS temp root
(/var/folders/.../T/corbanu-tests-XXXX/tmp, 75 bytes), so
<tmp>/.tmpXXXXXX/app-server-control/app-server-control.sock exceeds
sun_path and both control-socket tests fail with
"InvalidInput: path must be shorter than SUN_LEN" (150/152).

socket_test_dir() keeps the usual self-removing TempDir and moves to a
randomly named 0700 directory under /tmp only when the socket path would
not fit (103 bytes on macOS/BSD, 107 on Linux). The 0600 socket assertion
and the WebSocket upgrade/message/ping assertions are unchanged; no
production socket path or permission changes.
